note: The metric registry (Data Spine Phase 4). Every figure the pulse, the pages, the cards and Azimuth may state is defined ONCE here: what it counts, from which register, with which filters, over which window, and with how many samples before it may be said at all. Definitions are transcribed from scripts/build_pulse.py as it computes them today; a change of definition is a new version, never an edit in place. scripts/claims.py turns each computed figure into a claim that carries its definition, and the writer may cite a figure only through a claim.
rules: A sentence may state a figure only through a claim: metric id, value, scope, window, sample size and source body travel together.
Comparisons between windows (up, down, beat, record) are computed from two claims of the same metric by code, never by the writer.
A developer or project is attributed to a figure only through a registered project_id (lk_identity_xref), never by name.
A window whose last day is less than two days old is provisional: the DLD register back-fills (8 Sep 2026 read 526 sales on 9 Sep and 641 by 10 Sep).
A figure below its minimum sample is not stated, and the claim says so.

sources.dld_transactions: Dubai Land Department transactions register (DLD open data)
sources.dld_rents: Dubai Land Department Ejari rent contracts register (DLD open data)

metrics.label: Registered transactions (sales, mortgages and gifts)
metrics.definition: Rows of the transactions register inside the window that pass the shape gate: a dated instance, group Sales, Mortgage or Gifts, and a value (when present) above zero and under AED 5 bn.

metrics.label: Sales registered
metrics.definition: Transactions in group Sales inside the window, after the shape gate. By area: the register's own AREA_EN label.

metrics.label: Value of sales
metrics.definition: Sum of TRANS_VALUE over sales with a numeric value, in billions of dirhams, rounded to one decimal.

metrics.label: Median sale price
metrics.definition: Median TRANS_VALUE over sales with a numeric value.

metrics.label: Median residential sale price per square foot
metrics.definition: Median of TRANS_VALUE divided by ACTUAL_AREA (square metres) over residential sales with an area above 10 m2, divided by 10.7639 to give dirhams per square foot.

metrics.label: Rent contracts registered
metrics.definition: Ejari contracts in the window that pass the shape gate: a dated registration, version New or Renewed, and an annual amount (when present) between AED 1,000 and AED 5 m.

metrics.label: Residential single-unit contracts
metrics.definition: Residential contracts for a Unit or Villa with an annual amount, excluding bulk leases (TOTAL_PROPERTIES above 1 - the 48.9% phantom-yield lesson).

metrics.label: Median annual rent
metrics.definition: Median ANNUAL_AMOUNT over residential single-unit contracts.

metrics.label: Median annual rent per square foot
metrics.unit: AED per sq ft per year
metrics.definition: Median of ANNUAL_AMOUNT divided by ACTUAL_AREA over residential single-unit contracts with an area between 10 and 10,000 m2, divided by 10.7639.

metrics.label: Gross rental yield
metrics.definition: 100 x median annual rent per m2 (residential single-unit contracts, 10-10,000 m2) / median sale price per m2 (residential sales above 10 m2), the same area on both sides once marketing names are mapped to DLD areas through data/dld/area_alias.json. Stated only with at least 30 contracts AND 30 sales, and only inside the 1.5-12% canary band.
metrics.caution: The area mapping is only as good as area_alias.json. On 13 Sep 2026 the register showed seven labels mapped to the wrong DLD area (City of Arabia is Wadi Al Safa 4, not 2) - see data/identity/area_alias_evidence.csv.
